Ezekiel 1.summary: Among the exiles by the Chebar, Ezekiel sees a storm, four living creatures, wheels moving with them, and a radiant throne-like appearance above an expanse. He falls facedown when he sees the likeness of the LORD's glory (Ezekiel 1:1-28). The chapter introduces divine majesty beyond Jerusalem without identifying the vision's images as ordinary physical creatures.

These actions symbolize siege hardship and impurity; their durations remain debated.
